subscribers.notes: Region is Title Case. NO technology columns here. Use subscriber_technology for current tech.

devices.notes: is_5g_capable=1 means device has 5G hardware. volte_capable=1 means device supports VoLTE.

subscriber_technology.notes: Use current_technology for subscriber tech. current_cell_id links to kpis_daily for subscriber cell KPIs.

sites.notes: zone is nation-level: 'Earth Kingdom','Fire Nation','Water Tribe','Air Nomads'. region is city-level: 'Ba Sing Se', 'Omashu', etc.

cells.notes: technology column here is for network infrastructure. Use this to filter KPIs by technology (NOT kpis_daily). NO msisdn column.

kpis_daily.notes: NO msisdn column. NO technology column. Filter technology via JOIN cells. Filter region via JOIN cells→sites. dropped_call_rate is the correct column (NOT drop_rate).

coverage.notes: MANDATORY for upsell queries: verify technology actually available at subscriber location.

network_alarms.notes: is_active=1 for open alarms. Joins to cells→sites for location.

dou_monthly.notes: Multiple rows per subscriber (one per month). Always filter to latest month.

experience_incidents.notes: LIVE per-customer service-issue log with a lifecycle. 'right now / at this moment / currently / live' => WHERE status='active' (NOT a date filter). 'today at what time / timeline / when' => use started_at ('YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'); a resolved row keeps started_at + resolved_at forever. 'streaming' => affected_service='video streaming' (others: 'mobile data','voice calls','all services'). is_hvc / value_segment / region are snapshotted ON the row — NO join needed to filter HVCs. Order active issues by severity (critical>major>minor) then started_at. Incidents self-heal over minutes so active counts shift between asks.

customers.notes: NO region column. Get region from subscribers.region in SC DB. segment: prepaid/postpaid/enterprise.

subscriptions.notes: ALWAYS filter is_current=1. Multiple rows per subscriber (plan history). Bridge table to plans.

plans.notes: supports_5g=1 means plan ALLOWS 5G but subscriber may not be using it yet.

customer_value.notes: 6 rows per subscriber (monthly history). ALWAYS filter to MAX(month). is_hvc=1 for HVC. value_segment: bronze/silver/gold/platinum. churn_label: low/medium/high.

billing.notes: NO region column. JOIN subscribers for region. One row per subscriber per month.

relationships.purpose: Get technology or site for KPI rows
Get region, city, or nation for cells
Get technology or site for alarms
Get current technology subscriber is on

relationships.join: JOIN coverage cov ON s.msisdn=cov.msisdn AND cov.technology_available='5G'
relationships.purpose: Verify technology available at subscriber location

relationships.join: JOIN kpis_daily k ON st.current_cell_id=k.cell_id AND k.date=(SELECT MAX(date) FROM kpis_daily)
relationships.purpose: Get KPI metrics for a subscriber's current cell

relationships.join: JOIN dou_monthly dm ON s.msisdn=dm.msisdn AND dm.month=(SELECT MAX(month) FROM dou_monthly)
JOIN mobility_profile mp ON s.msisdn=mp.msisdn AND mp.month=(SELECT MAX(month) FROM mobility_profile)
relationships.purpose: Get subscriber mobility class or FWA candidate flag

relationships.join: JOIN qoe_daily q ON s.msisdn=q.msisdn AND q.date=(SELECT MAX(date) FROM qoe_daily)
JOIN experience_incidents ei ON s.msisdn=ei.msisdn AND ei.status='active'
relationships.purpose: Get a subscriber's live/active service issues. Often NO join is needed — experience_incidents already carries region/value_segment/is_hvc, so query it directly for 'HVCs with an active streaming issue right now'.

relationships.join: JOIN subscriptions sub ON c.msisdn=sub.msisdn AND sub.is_current=1
relationships.purpose: Get current plan for a customer

relationships.join: JOIN op.customer_value cv ON s.msisdn=cv.msisdn AND cv.month=(SELECT MAX(month) FROM op.customer_value)
relationships.purpose: Get ARPU, HVC status, churn risk for a subscriber

relationships.join: JOIN op.billing b ON s.msisdn=b.msisdn AND b.billing_month=(SELECT MAX(billing_month) FROM op.billing)
relationships.purpose: Get billing amount or payment status for a subscriber

kpi_by_region.description: KPI averages broken down by region
kpi_by_region.sql_pattern: kpis_daily k JOIN cells c ON k.cell_id=c.cell_id JOIN sites si ON c.site_id=si.site_id

kpi_by_technology.description: KPI averages broken down by technology (2G/3G/4G/5G)
kpi_by_technology.sql_pattern: kpis_daily k JOIN cells c ON k.cell_id=c.cell_id

subscriber_cell_kpi.description: Get KPI metrics for a subscriber's current cell
subscriber_cell_kpi.sql_pattern: subscribers s JOIN subscriber_technology st ON s.msisdn=st.msisdn JOIN kpis_daily k ON st.current_cell_id=k.cell_id

upsell_5g.description: Find 5G upsell candidates: device capable + in 5G coverage area
upsell_5g.sql_pattern: subscribers s JOIN devices d ON s.msisdn=d.msisdn JOIN subscriber_technology st ON s.msisdn=st.msisdn
upsell_5g.filter: WHERE d.is_5g_capable=1 AND st.current_technology != '5G' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM coverage cv WHERE cv.msisdn=s.msisdn AND cv.technology_available='5G')

hvc_with_network.description: HVC subscribers with their network quality data
hvc_with_network.sql_pattern: subscribers s JOIN subscriber_technology st ON s.msisdn=st.msisdn JOIN kpis_daily k ON st.current_cell_id=k.cell_id AND k.date=(SELECT MAX(date) FROM kpis_daily) JOIN op.customer_value cv ON s.msisdn=cv.msisdn AND cv.month=(SELECT MAX(month) FROM op.customer_value)

subscriber_plan.description: Get a subscriber's current plan details
subscriber_plan.sql_pattern: subscribers s JOIN op.subscriptions sub ON s.msisdn=sub.msisdn AND sub.is_current=1 JOIN op.plans p ON sub.plan_id=p.plan_id

alarm_location.description: Active alarms with their region and technology context
alarm_location.sql_pattern: network_alarms a JOIN cells c ON c.cell_id=a.cell_id JOIN sites si ON si.site_id=c.site_id

fwa_candidates.sql_pattern: mobility_profile mp JOIN subscribers s ON mp.msisdn=s.msisdn
fwa_candidates.filter: WHERE mp.is_fwa_candidate=1 AND mp.month=(SELECT MAX(month) FROM mobility_profile)

churn_risk.description: Churn risk subscribers with their ARPU and value segment
churn_risk.filter: WHERE cv.month=(SELECT MAX(month) FROM customer_value) AND cv.churn_label IN ('medium','high')

revenue_by_region.description: Total revenue or ARPU by region — requires cross-DB join
revenue_by_region.sql_pattern: subscribers s JOIN op.customer_value cv ON s.msisdn=cv.msisdn AND cv.month=(SELECT MAX(month) FROM op.customer_value)

constraints.kpis_daily: ALWAYS filter: k.date=(SELECT MAX(date) FROM kpis_daily) — historical average is misleading
constraints.customer_value: ALWAYS filter: cv.month=(SELECT MAX(month) FROM customer_value) — 6 rows per subscriber, omitting filter inflates by 6x
constraints.billing: ALWAYS filter: b.billing_month=(SELECT MAX(billing_month) FROM billing) — one row per subscriber per month
constraints.dou_monthly: ALWAYS filter: dm.month=(SELECT MAX(month) FROM dou_monthly) — multiple rows per subscriber
constraints.mobility_profile: ALWAYS filter: mp.month=(SELECT MAX(month) FROM mobility_profile)
constraints.qoe_daily: ALWAYS filter: q.date=(SELECT MAX(date) FROM qoe_daily)
constraints.subscriptions: ALWAYS filter: sub.is_current=1 — multiple rows per subscriber (plan history)
constraints.network_alarms: ALWAYS filter: a.is_active=1 for open alarms
constraints.coverage: MANDATORY for upsell: verify EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM coverage cv WHERE cv.msisdn=s.msisdn AND cv.technology_available='5G')

wrong_columns.kpis_daily.technology: kpis_daily has NO technology column — filter via JOIN cells c ON k.cell_id=c.cell_id WHERE c.technology='5G'
wrong_columns.kpis_daily.region: kpis_daily has NO region column — go through JOIN cells c ON k.cell_id=c.cell_id JOIN sites si ON c.site_id=si.site_id
wrong_columns.cells.msisdn: cells has NO msisdn column — cells joins via cell_id only
wrong_columns.subscribers.technology: subscribers has NO technology column — use subscriber_technology.current_technology
wrong_columns.customers.region: op.customers has NO region column — JOIN subscribers s ON s.msisdn=c.msisdn for region
wrong_columns.billing.region: op.billing has NO region column — JOIN subscribers s ON s.msisdn=b.msisdn for region
wrong_columns.subscriber_technology.monthly_data_usage: No such column — use dou_monthly.total_data_gb for usage
wrong_columns.plans.msisdn: plans has NO msisdn — always join through subscriptions: JOIN subscriptions sub ON s.msisdn=sub.msisdn AND sub.is_current=1 JOIN plans p ON sub.plan_id=p.plan_id

cross_db.note: NetworkAnalyzer (SC) and Operator (OP) share msisdn as the join key
cross_db.op_prefix: Always prefix operator tables with 'op.' when using ATTACH
cross_db.query_function: Cross-DB queries use QUERY_BOTH and run via query_sc() with ATTACH
cross_db.pure_op_queries: If query only touches operator tables, use QUERY_OP directly (no ATTACH needed)
